model_output.verdict: A distribution supervisor with a clear progression and shift responsibilities, but little on what changed under your watch.
write_up: You come across as an outbound supervisor who worked up from picking and now runs a night shift. The work is easy to follow, though a recruiter may hesitate over what your scheduling, training and carrier coordination achieved.

The line about supervising 35 associates across picking, packing and loading is the model: it names the shift, the people and the work. Add a few specifics about order volume, training or changes on the floor where you can verify them.
